items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When you got people like Warren Buffet saying, “I got a lot of money. I want to pay more taxes.”

ctx.x: We’re fed enough to pacify us for a minute or two and say, oh, okay. We got Obama in, or whatever. We’re pacified for a minute or two. But then when the smog clears, it’s wait a minute. We’re not that much better off. So now that you’ve raised that issue – but who are these people? Maybe this is all made up. Maybe it’s all made up. I don’t know.
